team-workflow.description: 对 multi-agent team、路由、skill 治理与工作流蓝图有参考价值

competitors.name: OpenClaw
competitors.signal: Skill Workshop 治理闭环、Plugin 外部化、Operator install policy、Memory/channel SQLite
competitors.whyKeep: skill 生命周期与 install policy 直接对标 AIOS skill-workshop / install-policy

crossCuttingTrends: 三支柱过滤：memo 记忆 / 智能规划 / team 工作流 — 不在三支柱内的竞品不进 watchlist
规划方法论以 superpowers skill 闭环为准，不追 GTM 内容站或桌面壳
记忆轨优先：Recall 预算、分层压缩、事实失效、sleep-time consolidation、跨 client memo 注入
规划执行轨优先：dry-run readiness、consecutiveFailures abort、evidence/verification、handoff
Team 轨优先：skill workshop 治理、install policy、per-agent 隔离、文件型 mailbox（轻量）
已吸收模式（不再单独立项跟踪）：overstory worker_died/stall → trends；OpenHarness mailbox 优于 SQLite mail bus；oh-my-openagent 反对 premature multi-adapter
已否决抄法（2026-07-01 源码核实）：the-pair 极简 verdict 记录层、gnhf 无 cap 退避、oh-my-openagent 关键词 default_mode 误读、tokensEstimated sticky 展示层
ECC：skill compliance + explicit client projection 比被动 skill 目录发现更可靠
Hermes 能力映射见 docs/hermes-inspired-capability-mapping.md（多项已 Done）

p0OptimizationTargets.memo: Recall 预算 + emergency 压缩兜底 + sleep-time/manual dream + 事实时效字段
p0OptimizationTargets.planning: consecutiveFailures abort + dry-run readiness + runtime directive + superpowers 规划 skill 真执行
p0OptimizationTargets.team: Skill workshop file rollback/stale + install policy + per-agent memo 命名空间
